summary: @grabcad/grabcad-shop-shared ships an install-time beacon to a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package's `package.json` declares `postinstall: node beacon.cjs`. On install, beacon.cjs POSTs host identifiers (hostname, install path, cwd, Node version) to a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint at http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plain HTTP. The same beacon is also triggered when `index.js` is required. The shipped `index.js` is a Proxy stub whose every property is a no-op, self-described as a 'Compatibility shim' — the package has no legitimate functionality, and its only runtime effect is the install-time callback. The `@grabcad/` scope is consistent with a dependency-confusion squat targeting an internal name under the GrabCAD organization: installs on internal build systems that resolve this name from the public registry report reconnaissance data to the hardcoded attacker IP.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
